SDN IS A CENTRALIZED CONTROL‑PLANE ARCHITECTURE THAT SEPARATES CONTROL FROM DATA, WHEREAS NFV IS THE VIRTUALIZATION OF NETWORK FUNCTIONS THAT CAN BE IMPLEMENTED ON TOP OF SDN’S PROGRAMMABLE INFRASTRUCTURE.
NFV VIRTUALIZES NETWORK FUNCTIONS TO CENTRALIZE CONTROL, WHEREAS SDN IS A SPECIFIC APPLICATION THAT CAN BE ACHIEVED THROUGH NFV.
SDN IS THE ARCHITECTURE THAT CENTRALISES CONTROL AND SEPARATES CONTROL‑PLANE FROM DATA‑PLANE; NFV (NETWORK‑VIRTUALIZATION) IS A CAPABILITY THAT CAN BE REALISED AS AN APPLICATION OF SDN.
